name: create_directory
description: Create a new (empty) directory in the wiki. Git doesn't track empty dirs, so a tiny `.gitkeep` marker is committed inside. Use when the user wants a new section/folder before populating it with docs. The path must NOT end in `.md` and must not already exist as a file or directory. Only call after the user has explicitly asked for the directory or confirmed when you proposed it. Returns the commit SHA and the created path.

path.description: Wiki-relative directory path (e.g. `auth/admin`). No leading slash, no `..`, no `.md` extension. Parent directories are created as needed.

message.description: Short commit message summarizing the new directory (e.g. "add admin folder").
